prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1258; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured is represented by counsel or if you are aware of any other party with an interest in this claim, please advise us accordingly.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury liability limits and any other applicable coverage limits, along with confirmation of the policy number and effective dates.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions.
